info.title: Cisco IOS-XE IETF - ietf-diffserv-policy
info.description:
IETF standard data from `ietf-diffserv-policy` module.

**Root containers:** 1 (policies)
**Paths:** 16 | **Operations:** 64

Supports CRUD for read-write nodes, GET for read-only nodes.

get.description:
Retrieve policies from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace policies on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update policies on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove policies from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
